name: Twister
overview: An unprecedented series of violent tornadoes is sweeping across Oklahoma. Tornado chasers, headed by Dr. Jo Harding, attempt to release a groundbreaking device that will allow them to track them and create a more advanced warning system. They are joined by Jo's soon to be ex-husband Bill, a former tornado chaser himself, and his girlfriend Melissa.

name: Twister
overview: An oddball family on a Kansas farm are trapped in their farmhouse by an impending storm. The patriarch of the clan is a retired soda pop tycoon. He is currently dating a children's TV evangelist. Also living at the farm is his layabout daughter and her precocious 8 year old daughter, his would-be artist son, the son's fiancée, and the black maid. Also thrown into the mix is the daughter's ex-husband, a ne-er-do-well who is seeking to get back in his ex-wife's good graces.

name: Atomic Twister
overview: When tornadoes hit a nuclear power plant, critically damaging the plant's cooling system, the results could be catastrophic. Atomic Twister, a countdown to disaster, traces an extraordinary day in the lives of small town citizens who unexpectedly find themselves facing the possibility of mass destruction.

name: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

name: Mind Twister
overview: Two former exotic dancers devise a plot to expose a physciatrist as the murderer of their friend.

name: Twister
overview: Wind currents on a debris-strewn street corner.

name: Fire Twister
overview: Environmental activist Scott is accidentally involved in a bomb attack on a fuel storage facility. The gigantic explosion unleashes a roller of fire that rolls towards Los Angeles. Desperate, Scott and his colleagues want to save the city. But for the media they are considered to be the culprits - who will soon be hunted by killers ...

name: Texas Twister
overview: A small town worker believes he's seeing visions from God in the form of a violent tornado.

name: Christmas Twister
overview: During the holiday season, Ethan, a meteorologist, and his wife Addison, a TV news reporter, must put aside their differences and band together to help save others and rescue their missing children from a massive F6 twister that has unexpectedly descended upon their small Texas town.

name: Twister
overview: It's girls' night. Nanna and her friend smoke weed, giggle, and drink. But soon they run out. They could buy more, but they don't have enough money. A plowman would probably be enough, so Nanna has an idea. She knows a guy who would probably give them some money—he just wants something in return. And so the question is: What is 500 kroner really worth? A blowjob?

name: Naked Twister
overview: Two couples are enjoying a night of games when a it turns into something more sinister. They decide on a game of Truth or Dare and discover dark truths, perform dark dares, and reveal much more about themselves than any of them ever knew.

name: Twister
overview: Bobby, just out of a mental institution takes the identity of a man seeking to appropriate a big inheritance, not realizing that he may be getting into more troubles than he thought.
